mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt (po_id, received_by, received_at, carrier_reference, notes) VALUES (#{poId}, #{receivedBy}, #{receivedAt}, #{carrierReference}, #{notes})
INSERT INTO receipt_line (receipt_id, po_line_id, location_id, quantity_received, quantity_damaged) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{poLineId}, #{locationId}, #{quantityReceived}, #{quantityDamaged})
mapper.select: SELECT r.receipt_id, r.po_id, r.received_by, r.received_at, r.carrier_reference, r.notes, rl.receipt_line_id, rl.receipt_id AS line_receipt_id, rl.po_line_id, rl.location_id, rl.quantity_received, rl.quantity_damaged, p.sku, l.location_code FROM receipt r LEFT JOIN receipt_line rl ON rl.receipt_id = r.receipt_id LEFT JOIN purchase_order_line pol ON pol.po_line_id = rl.po_line_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pol.product_id LEFT JOIN location l ON l.location_id = rl.location_id WHERE r.receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY rl.receipt_line_id
